# Recreation Prompt

Recreate a portrait-first browser canvas game named **Rizzverse Rift Shooter**. It is mechanically a one-thumb mobile space shooter score-attack lane: the player steers a glowing canon skiff horizontally at the bottom of the screen, falling hazards descend from above, collectible RIZZ/BASED shards descend from above, score increases over time, pickups add +100, hazard contact immediately ends the run, and restart begins the same loop.

The public identity should satisfy this prompt: Space Shooter. A satirical game inspired by Spider-Verse built around space shooter play, with competitive, futuristic, multiplayer energy, with friends session design, search-friendly hooks like space shooter, shooter, arcade, aesthetics like neon aesthetic, neon noir, shonen aesthetic, and meme-tone cues such as rizz, based. Designed for one-thumb mobile play with touch-friendly interactions, responsive readability, fast onboarding, and portrait-first UX tuned for iOS and Android in the 4:7 to 9:16 range.

Use a satirical multiverse/comic-neon world without adding unprotected mechanics. Build an authored procedural scene with neon noir starfields, drifting comic rift panels, perspective lane lines, shonen impact words, a distinctive cyan/pink/gold player skiff, faceted cringe debris hazards, diamond reward shards, compact friends-session HUD copy, and mobile-readable start/game-over cards.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Source truth
- genre: portrait canvas arcade space runner / dodge-and-collect shooter-adjacent score attack
- objective: steer a small ship horizontally, survive falling hazards, collect reward objects, and increase score
- input model: one-thumb pointer/touch horizontal follow on the playfield; menu/restart use native button clicks
- core loop: start -> falling hazards and collectibles spawn -> player lerps toward pointer -> score ticks upward and pickups add +100 -> collision with hazard ends run -> restart
- fail/friction state: immediate game over on player/hazard overlap, final score shown, restart returns to same loop

## Protected mechanics
- Canvas requestAnimationFrame loop with capped delta time.
- Horizontal pointer-follow movement only; no new shooting buttons or second-stick controls.
- Randomized falling hazard and pickup spawns with vertical scrolling pressure.
- Collision semantics: hazard contact fails, pickup contact rewards.
- Score semantics: passive score over time plus +100 per collectible.
- Restart/reset semantics and mobile click/tap actionability.

## Safe theming surfaces
HUD vocabulary, title/menu copy, player/hazard/collectible silhouettes, particles, background scene, fonts, audio/GIF accents, score/meter labels, failure fantasy, and progression language.
